declarations.name: AuiSchemaForm

inputs.name: schema
inputs.description: JSON Schema subset (root type object); unsupported keywords throw a configuration error listing each pointer.

inputs.name: uiSchema
inputs.description: Presentation: widget, label, help, placeholder, order, columns, span, visibleIf, rows, orientation, disableNonWorking, addLabel, patternMessage; children under fields, array items under items.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Initial value; values that do not match the schema type are ignored. reset() returns to it.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the form. Default: the schema title.

inputs.name: submitLabel
inputs.description: Submit button text. Default: localized Submit.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disable every field and the actions.

inputs.name: businessCalendar
inputs.description: Working days and holidays for the date pickers; disableNonWorking in the UI schema uses it.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: IANA time zone of date-time fields. Default: the global configuration.

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Async validation after the constraint checks pass; return messages by JSON Pointer.

inputs.name: showActions
inputs.description: Show the submit (and optional reset) buttons.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of messages and of the rendered controls.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: Any edit, including array add, remove, and move: { value, pointer }. Control events do not leave the form.

outputs.name: invalidSubmit
outputs.description: Submission blocked: { errors: [{ pointer, label, message }] }.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: The current value as JSON; hidden and empty optional fields are left out.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear messages.

methods.name: setErrors
methods.description: Show errors by JSON Pointer on fields, groups, or the summary.

methods.name: focusField
methods.description: Move focus to the field at a pointer; false when it is not visible.

accessibility.pattern: Native form with labelled AbsoluteUI controls (each follows its own APG pattern), Fieldset groups for objects and arrays, and the GOV.UK-style Error Summary from Form.

limitations: Conditions compare values with equals, notEquals, in, and filled, combined with all, any, and not.
Arrays of arrays are not supported; array items are primitives or objects.
Reordering array entries rebuilds their controls (focus moves to the corresponding action button).
